quest.title: Lovely Dreams
quest.description: Unexpectedly, the final clue leads back to Mt. Aocang. Did Yuandai once live there? Why didn't Cloud Retainer mention this? Either way, time to head back there and see if Yuandai recalls anything.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Primogem x60, Mora x38100, Guide to Gold x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x8

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, just tell Paimon already! What's this thing you've prepared?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Here. This is it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? But isn't this the mechanism that you were tinkering with when we first got here? Is it another invention of yours?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Precisely. A recent one at that. I am most pleased with the result. I call it the "Suspensus Somnium Mechanism."

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It periodically releases a soft breeze which, when paired with a gentle adeptal tune, can help the listener subconsciously relax, and even enter a semi-hypnotic state.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Soothing agitation and anxiety, relieving exhaustion and insomnia... Its potential uses are numerous indeed. And of course, it can also aid in the recovery of lost memories.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, what a cool gadget! But if you had it all along, why did you keep it to yourself until just now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We could have come to Mt. Aocang right off the bat and saved Paimon a lot of floating!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: How preposterous. Had Yuandai not recalled much of her past through her own efforts, the device would have nothing to draw upon.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: We adepti can only help those who first resolve to help themselves. Had she lacked such determination and strength of character, one would have little to offer in way of assistance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks she gets it now... Hey, what's that other thing?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: As previously mentioned, a gentle adeptal tune is required to take full advantage of the mechanism. One secured such a tune from Streetward Rambler. Only with her melodies can the mechanism reach its peak power.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah... Paimon can feel what you mean! Paimon's body feels light as a feather — it's as if she's lying down on a warm patch of grass after a super satisfying meal... *yawn*...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: And you, Yuandai? Is the mechanism helping you to relax?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It appears she has already succumbed to the depths of reverie. Come, join one on this side. We shall give her some time to herself.
The drought is over... But why do you look like you want to cry?
The potion... It's nearly run its course...
I've never regretted meeting you... not even for a second.
Please... Please, no...
Have you forgotten?
This is the world you left behind, one of gentle breeze and morning dew, perfectly straddled betwixt the realms of heaven and earth...
This is your home. This is where you belong. You should have never left... The "you" of the past... the "me" from not that long ago... We should have never...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Ah... Ahhhh...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: So that is the truth... No wonder this place is so familiar. I—

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Granny!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Granny! Are you okay!?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Cloud... Retainer...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Your memories have returned?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, did you just call her by her full name? Does that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You already knew each other!?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Yes. I now remember everything. Everything...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Granny, please don't cry. I'm here, I'm here...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Don't worry, my dear child. Granny is fine...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry, everyone. You've gone to so much trouble on my behalf...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: It's all come back to me now. The most important thing that I had forgotten... was the truth of "what I once was."

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: *sigh* One can sense the guilt that now plagues your conscience. Reclaiming a truth long buried is sure to come with a myriad of complex emotions. Perhaps one should recount the story on your behalf while you compose yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: No, it's okay. Now that I've remembered, I must face my memories head-on.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Shuyu, everyone... I cannot thank you enough for all your help. I'm ready to tell you my story... if you're willing to listen.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Please, Granny, don't force yourself. What happened in the past doesn't matter... I love you more than anything. Nothing you say can change that.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I know, dear child. My feelings for you are exactly the same... It is for this reason that you deserve to know the truth.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Some time ago, I made a terrible mistake... One for which I could never atone.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the "sin" that you mentioned in Jueyun Karst? What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: ...I am, in truth, not a human being. My real form — one that I held for centuries — was that of a wild crane.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I spent many, many years living on Mt. Aocang, bathing in the soft breeze and drinking the sweet dew of the mountains. At some point, I somehow gained wisdom and sentience. The lord of the mountain, Cloud Retainer, became aware of my existence and began to share many stories with me. She even passed on the secret of cultivation to me.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Though she never took me on as a formal disciple, I always saw her as my Master. Whenever she took out her tools to work on mechanisms or new inventions, I would also stand next to her and watch.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I even contemplated completing my training and becoming an adeptus in my own right. I followed her teachings, and time gradually passed us by... until that fateful day fifty years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Fifty years ago?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: During the drought that struck Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: That's right. Master regaled me with many stories of her past deeds. From them, I learned how she had saved people from a similar crisis in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: She was the one I looked up to the most. More than anything, I dreamt of becoming an adeptus like her. I wanted to travel the land like she had, relieving suffering wherever I went.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: But I was still far from being a real adeptus. I possessed no ability to take on human form and fit in with the crowd. Once she learned of my desires, Master prepared a special dose of Human Mimicry Potion for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: She warned me that the potion's effects would only last ten years, and if I were to fail to return to my original form at the end of that time, I would forever forget my past as a crane, and become something neither human, beast, nor adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... So that was... the source of your "dementia" all along?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But you never turned back into a crane...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Was it because of Grandpa?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Indeed. I fell in love... Though he was human, he had spent his entire life training on Mt. Tianheng. When we met, it was not only my first foray into the world below, but his as well.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Although clumsy and impulsive as he was, you'd think he was the real "strange bird" among the two of us. But still, just like me, he cared deeply about the world, and wanted, more than anything, to cleanse it of all pain and suffering.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I could not help but fall for him. But my time continued to tick away... Those ten years passed by in a flash. Yet I did not want to leave his side, so I... I...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no... What happened next?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: ... I committed an offense. I wanted to stay with him, even if it meant living a life full of pain and suffering, even if it meant that I would eventually turn into a monstrosity.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I knew I had betrayed Master's hopes, but I was too ashamed to face her. So I wrote her a long letter instead and asked someone to leave it outside her abode.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I was convinced that she would not support my decision, and I lacked the courage to speak to her face-to-face. In my shame, I fled and tried to hide from the world, such that no one would be able to find me again.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: But that was only the beginning of my troubles. I began to suffer from a strange illness. My memories became hazy and confused, and I could no longer keep myself awake. I understood that my pain was caused by my refusal to return to the life I was fated to lead.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Along with my memories as a crane, I soon forgot the true cause of my suffering as well. I knew only that I had committed a sin. All I could do was pray for forgiveness, even if I had long forgotten what needed to be forgiven.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Looking back, I was beyond lucky to have come across that traveling merchant at Wangshu Inn. It was such a fortunate coincidence that we were there at the same time. If it weren't for those Soul-Revitalizing Teapills, I probably would have—

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: ...Coincidence? Why did I ever think it was a coincidence? Teapills concocted using the blood of an adeptus... No... It couldn't be—

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Master. Don't tell me... Back then, that merchant was actually—

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: Human custom would dictate the conferral of gifts to be in order when one's progeny is wedded, would it not? Consider the pills a symbol of one's best wishes.

response.speaker: Yuandai
response.text: Ahh... So when I tried to conceal my name and mistakes from the world, and hide myself away in perpetuity, the only person I managed to deceive.... was myself. You knew where I was all along.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One still remembers when you were but a fledgling, you possessed a certain fondness for a particular game. You would hide yourself among a group of wild cranes and ask one to pick you out from among the flock.

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: One found you with such ease every time. 'Tis a truth most evident: One always recognizes one's own... no matter what form they may take.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... Cloud Retainer, you found Yuandai again? But how? When? And what happened after that?

response.speaker: Xianyun
response.text: ...Hah. Perhaps it is now time for one to recount the rest of the tale.

choices.text: The nameless heroine hid herself away...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, about your move to Liyue Harbor... You gonna tell the other adepti about it?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: I have left an explanatory note in my abode. Those two old fossils will discover it, I am sure, should they come seeking my company.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Considering their recent penchant for going off on... private escapades, however, I find myself caring little for how they shall receive this news, hmph.

talks.objective: Listen to Xianyun give an account about the truth of the past

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What seems like a book of accounts. A letter can also be found inside.)

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: Little Yu, my dear daughter... By the time you read this, Mommy and Daddy will have already left to go on a long journey.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: Your Granny may get a little forgetful sometimes, so try to jot down little reminders for her around the house whenever you can. Mommy and Daddy are counting on you to take care of Granny while we're gone!

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: You might be wondering why Mommy and Daddy have to leave. Well, my dear daughter, in this world, everyone's got something that they just have to do. Your Mommy and Daddy are no different!

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: Did you know? Daddy was actually awfully sick as a child. How sick, you might ask? Well, even the doctor could barely feel Daddy's pulse, it was that weak!

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: But Daddy still managed to grow up. Looking back, there were many times when Daddy thought he might not make it. In the end, though, Daddy pushed through every time. Pretty amazing, if you think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: Maybe Daddy is just really lucky. Or, who knows, maybe he has some super powerful adeptus looking out for him? Either way, Daddy has always felt like he's received a lot of love from this world.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: And you know what? Daddy loves this world right back. They told Daddy that this mission would be super dangerous, but both Mommy and Daddy decided to sign up.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: You'll have grown quite a bit taller the next time Mommy and Daddy see you again. Maybe you'll be so big by then that Mommy and Daddy won't even recognize you.

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: How about this? Let's use a code! Do you still remember that one phrase Daddy taught you when you were little? That can be our secret code the next time we see each other again. That way, we'll recognize each other no matter what. You remember it, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Unsigned Letter
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, evil shall never prevail.

talks.objective: Follow the memories to find the truth (0/3)

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: We meet again, dear friends. How did everything go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! And it's all thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You quickly go over the whole story with Xingqiu.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Ah, I see... So the stories didn't get it right after all. Even though she was a celebrated heroine, she had to bear a heavy burden that most could not hope to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Thank goodness for the help of that adeptus. At least she was able to recover what she had lost.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Although I cannot claim to know exactly how their story will unfold from here, I trust the ending will be a happy one. Those united in a common purpose always find a way back to each other in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Xingqiu
dialogues.text: Thank you for helping me fill in the gaps. And don't worry — I'll keep this all to myself. It's not my story to tell, after all.

talks.objective: Follow the memories to find the truth (0/3)

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: In truth, one had more than a few misgivings about your chosen partner. As an exorcist, his talent was lacking. One could hardly say his skill with sigils was any better.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: But soon, one came to appreciate the devotion he bestowed upon you during your illness. He never uttered a complaint and rarely left your side.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Unwilling to begrudge someone of such character, one decided to overlook his aforementioned deficiencies... glaring though they may have been.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Wishing to grant you a life without regrets, one gathered many divine ingredients and used one's own blood to create a form of medicine. Though imperfect, it managed to suppress the more dire effects of your illness.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: As for how to deliver the medicine... After much contemplation, one eventually decided to perform the deed oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One took great care to alter one's features and select the appropriate attire. Only after meticulous scrutiny did one finally set out for Wangshu Inn.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: As one expected, you were most ignorant of one's true identity. You showed not even the slightest inkling of recognition.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: *sigh* One was quite torn... Should one have celebrated the success of one's disguise, or mourned the loss of your acquaintance?

talks.objective: Follow the memories to find the truth (1/3)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, Shuyu, we have a friend who helped us learn a lot of information about your Granny. Is it okay if we tell him the full story?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Sure! I don't think Granny would mind... As long as you don't tell a whole bunch of people.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I don't think she'd want too many people to know. They might go to Mt. Aocang and start bugging her about it. Granny needs to focus on her training, y'know? But, telling a friend or two is probably fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No worries! Our friend can keep a secret!

talks.objective: Destroy the evil spirits that surge forth

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Those monsters would hardly have pursued you with such ferocity without sufficient incentive. They were likely incited by the presence of godly remains.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Said godly remains, in turn, were likely drawn to the trace of one's scent on your body.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One was, after all, an active participant in the Archon War. Some of the gods were likely "shattered" by contraptions of one's very making.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: In the end, one was relieved to see you endure through the night. At the break of dawn, one heard an infant's cry pierce through the air, and one saw you carefully cradle the child to your chest. Although certain mortal matters remain foreign to me, one could not help but be moved by your joy.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: To see you happy, that was more than enough.

talks.objective: Follow the memories to find the truth (1/3)
Follow the memories to find the truth (2/3)

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Just as Yuandai troubled one with her antics, so did you give one many a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Upon finding you burning with fever, one made plans to bring you back to one's abode for treatment. However, upon seeing one's form, you began to cry, refusing to get on one's back.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: When one asked you why... Hah! Apparently, you believed that one could not possibly be a true adeptus, because "all illuminated cranes are white from tip to toe."

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One had no choice but to apply powder to one's body to conceal the variegated nature of one's appearance. You became more than amenable enough when one stood before you devoid of any other coloring.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It bears mentioning, however, that as a crane, Yuandai was nearly entirely pure white in color. Though you had never encountered her in that form, you still recognized the essence of her being...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Perhaps fate brought you two together in more ways than one.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Now all has been revealed.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One owes you an apology, Yuandai. One recognized you upon your very entrance into Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has always viewed you as a disciple of equal standing with Ganyu and Shenhe. Indeed, one wished to bring your story to a satisfactory end with this visit to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Still, one could not reveal your identity right away. Had one simply informed you of all you had lost, all those cherished memories would merely have become the fictionalized account of another.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Memories are most meaningful when recalled by the those who lived through them, would you not agree? Even if the process was painful and arduous to experience. Have you any further inquiries?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Master... I...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I must ask... If you found me all those years ago, why did you leave me be even though you knew about my mistake? Why did you not bring me back to Mt. Aocang by force?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has never regarded your action as a mistake. It was a simple choice, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: When it is time for one's progeny to leave the nest, it is the responsibility of an elder to let them fly free. Yet when your wings grow weary and the night grows dark, just know that you always have a place to which to return.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Tis a refuge referred to by many a name in mortal writing: "Home," "nest," "haven"... Whatever its denomination may be, its essence remains quite unchanged.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One speaks, of course, of a place not unlike one's own abode. One's disciples are free to come and go as they wish, yet the door remains forever open to those who wish to return... One rather hopes you count yourself among them.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you... I just... Thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Yuandai.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One expects you, too, have sensed the rapid deterioration of your condition as of late, have you not?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Forty years ago, you chose a path without a future. Though one used one's own blood to provide you with a few decades of extra time, it merely delayed the inevitable. One may have extended the path, yet one was unable to alter its final destination.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Even the power of an adeptus has its limits. Had your condition continued to deteriorate, you would have forgotten your life as a human entirely. In the end, you would have turned into a creature lacking in the ability to even comprehend its own monstrousness.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Fortunately, you were able to avoid that scenario by reclaiming your memories. Though one sped the process along by providing some guidance, the result is entirely a reflection of your own effort.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: So... what's gonna happen to Granny?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One will help her reclaim her original form as a wild crane. If it be fated, she may recover her sentience one day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's gotta go back to being a regular crane, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there no other way?

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Master... You've already done more than enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I don't know how I can possibly repay your kindness. This is a better result than I could have ever hoped for... How much time do I have left?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...Not long. The transformation is imminent.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Granny... Please don't leave, okay? You're all I have left... Please...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Don't be sad, dear child. Granny has led a wonderful life... My only regret is having to leave you behind.

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Don't forget to eat well, okay? A growing young lady like yourself needs lots of good food to grow big and strong. Promise Granny you'll take good care of yourself when I'm gone...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I promise, Granny... I'll do whatever you say...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: Good girl, good girl... Don't worry. It's not goodbye forever. Granny's gonna become the most formidable crane in all of Mt. Aocang. Granny will train day and night...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: ...I won't stop until I can turn into a human without having to rely on anything but my own power. When that day comes, we'll be able to live together again, you and I... How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Good...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: That's a good girl. Even though we won't see each other for a little while... As long as we both work hard, we're sure to meet again someday.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I—I'll eat well, Granny, I promise! And I'll wait for you, no matter how long it takes! I'll wait for you to come back!

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: That's my good girl... Then, Granny really has no more regrets...

dialogues.speaker: Yuandai
dialogues.text: I'm so sorry, Master... Thank you... For everything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shuyu...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Let her be. At her age, crying is a natural, if not fitting, response to such an event.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Tears are a necessary part of maturation. Sometimes, there is scarcely a better vehicle to wash away the toll of stress and misery.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Now that the issue has been resolved, you should also take a moment to relax. Give yourself some time to rest, take a nap if you must. One will wake you in due time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *snore*... Grilled Chicken Drumsticks... Nom nom nom...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Was Paimon sleeping just now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon wasn't talking to you! Paimon had a dream about eating grilled chicken drumsticks, that's all!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Madam... Adeptus...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Shuyu, you're awake. How do you feel?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I...I feel... a little better, thanks. I know I'll see Granny again someday, so I don't feel so sad anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Madame... Adeptus, could I, uh, ask you something? Would you... take me in as a disciple?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh? And have you reasons for this sudden interest?

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I know Granny thought that what she did back then was wrong. She felt really bad about it.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: But... Without that mistake, I would have never been born.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Even though Granny lost her memories, she never forgot to show me how much she loved me. So, I thought maybe one day...

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: I could become a cool adeptus like you and help a whole bunch of people, just like Granny wanted to do!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Upon some reflection, one supposes you are no mere mortal. The fact that Yuandai's blood flows through your veins is proof enough of that... If this is what you desire, one shall make it so.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Madame Adeptus! No, uh, I mean, Master!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Shuyu, are you sure about this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's gonna let you in on a little secret... We've seen Cloud Retainer's two other disciples, and they pretty much eat nothing but bitter herbs like Qingxin and Violetgrass!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you join them, you'll never enjoy Wanmin Restaurant's delicious cooking ever again!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph, how utterly preposterous. One has never enforced such a rule.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Every individual must find their own path to enlightenment. So long as one retains a pureness of spirit, one's dietary proclivities are quite irrelevant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you say that, but Paimon's not seeing any tasty treats up here, now is she?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Although Mt. Aocang is rich in natural beauty, its location does preclude access to certain finer mortal comforts.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: That is precisely why one plans to relocate to Liyue Harbor. Shuyu shall have the honor of becoming one's first disciple in the human world.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, you're leaving Mt. Aocang?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that why you took on this human form?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has never concerned oneself with the location of one's residence. From the very beginning, one has sought only solace and peace.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Yet, in the end, all of one's disciples ended up in Liyue Harbor. Ganyu, Shenhe... Yuandai... They all chose a life among the mortal world.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has reflected on this fact for many years now. One can only assume that it is due to some failing on one's part as an elder or master, a failing, perhaps, of recognizing what it was they truly wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One is most curious as to what aspect of Liyue Harbor could have enticed them to remain there. One could hardly offer an opinion on the matter, but perhaps some time in the harbor will prove instructive.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Why are you all so silent?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon is, uh, just a bit shocked, that's all... So does this mean we can grab a meal together in Liyue Harbor some time?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph! One has precious little time to squander! However... If one finds oneself otherwise unoccupied, one would not be opposed to the idea.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One will be assuming the identity of a human while residing in Liyue Harbor. You should take care to avoid disclosing one's true identity.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry! We'll help you keep it a secret.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So uh... when can we expect to start seeing you in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Perhaps in two day's time. One has some matters to see to before one's departure. Preparation is the key to success, after all. One plans to put up various items from one's collection for sale. The earnings should provide for a comfortable living in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has already picked out a handsome property near Chihu Rock. 'Tis no small purchase, but what is mortal life if not one expense after another...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like you've really thought of everything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... How about we meet up in Liyue Harbor in two days?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: A sensible plan. See you then.

talks.objective: Go to Liyue Harbor to see Xianyun

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Your concerns are excessive and unfounded. This is but a simple collection of ordinary valuables. Such intense scrutiny is hardly necessary.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: ...Er, to be quite honest, your insistence on that fact is my primary cause for concern...

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: In what way are any of these "ordinary"!? Every single item here could be worth more than everything I own combined! I simply can't risk shelling out that kind of Mora without proper scrutiny. If I'm wrong, I would never be able to earn it back, not even if I worked every single day for the rest of my life.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: I have to be careful. Yes, you can never be too careful...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here, Cloud— Er, Miss Xianyun! What are you guys arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ah, perfect timing! This ignoramus is questioning the authenticity of my wares!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: I'll have you know, these items have remained untouched in my personal collection for several hundred years. To question their legitimacy is pure folly!

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Several... hundred years?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: I—Indeed. *ahem* They're... family heirlooms, you see. Passed down over many generations. As families are wont to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! Yup! They've definitely... been around awhile. We can vouch for her on that one!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hear that? Had I not found myself in need of Mora, I would scarcely have had the heart to part with them. Indeed, you should consider it an honor to even have the opportunity to behold them with your own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Doubt their authenticity any further, and I may just decide to take them to another buyer.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Woah, woah, woah! Please don't go! I apologize for any insult, Miss. You see, I know full well that I lack the knowledge to judge the true worth of these items. If you could wait but a moment, I've hired an expert to appraise them for me... He should be here shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: #An "expert," you say? ...Very well. I will wait for a little while longer, then. {NICKNAME}, Paimon — this is my new residence. If you have cause to seek my company in the future, this is where you can find me.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Master... Oh, it's you two again. Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shuyu! You got a new outfit! It looks great on you!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Mhm, Master made it for me. I like it too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? You know how to make clothes?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmph! Do I "know how to make clothes"? With the support of the proper mechanism, sewing is hardly a challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Master, I brought in most of my stuff. There's a few boxes left, but they're kinda heavy, so I just left them outside...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Fret not. I shall help you move them into your room.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: A—Actually, I should probably, uh, sort through my stuff a bit first. Everything's kinda... messy right now, so maybe you could, um, not look yet, Master? Yeah, that'd be great...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Heh. It appears my young apprentice has her own fair share of secrets. No matter — do what you must, child.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Now, this "expert" you mentioned... When can we expect their arrival?

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Soon, soon... Ah! There he is!

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Here, allow me to make some introductions! This is Mr. Zhongli, a well-respected consultant at Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, and an expert in all manner of valuables and antiques!

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Mr. Zhongli... This is Ms. Xianyun. She's the one who's looking to sell the collection of valuables I mentioned earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ah, if it isn't Ms. Xianyun. It has been quite some time since our last meeting. What a serendipitous reunion.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ahem, in—indeed, most serendipitous. Have you been faring well as of late, Mr. Zhongli?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Quite well, thank you. I was fortunate enough over the past few days to enjoy both a stroll in the mountains and a fresh brew of tea from the most recent harvest. The experiences left me with much insight and peace.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Huh... So you two are already acquainted?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Indeed. How fortunate we are that fate has brought us together again. If you are otherwise unaware, allow me to inform you that Ms. Xianyun is a well-regarded collector and appraiser. She is well-versed in all fields and oft-celebrated for her impeccable taste. You stand to gain much from this opportunity.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You are too kind, Mr. Zhongli. True collectors pride themselves on their wealth of knowledge and eye for detail. I can say without a doubt that you are foremost in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Why, you flatter me, Ms. Xianyun. It would seem that you are as self-effacing as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Not at all, Mr. Zhongli, not at all.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Umm...

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: While I am loath to butt into this conversation, I must ask...

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: You two already knew each other, and you... seem to have quite a cordial relationship... Can I be certain that you're not working together to swindle me? I mean, you never know, haha...

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hah, a preposterous accusation! The heavens themselves would collapse before we would conspire to do such a thing!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Ms. Xianyun speaks the truth. Contracts are built on honesty and trust. If that proves to be beyond your capabilities in this instance, this transaction may be taken elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Say no more. Let us depart.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: A—Ah, I jest, I jest! What fool would still harbor doubts after Mr. Zhongli himself has vouched for the goods? Ms. Xianyun, Ms. Xianyun, wait—!

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Ahem... I deeply apologize for doubting you. So, um, Mr. Zhongli... Could you please give me a final verdict on the value of these items?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: There is no cause for concern. They are indeed rare and precious valuables. Take this mechanism, for instance. Though one may not immediately perceive its purpose, its structure and appearance are exquisite enough to merit it a place in any fine home.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: The same can be said for this one here. Few could hope to possess an item that so perfectly blends mechanical wonder with geometric grace.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: I am sure you have heard from your travels that the study of mechanisms is among the most wondrous arts in this world. With that in mind, I earnestly recommend procuring every last item in this collection.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Alright! Since I hired you as my consultant, Mr. Zhongli, I shall, of course, trust your good opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Then, in that case, Ms. Xianyun, I'll take the lot. However... since the final sum is quite large, how about we start with an initial deposit through the Northland Bank?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: The Northland Bank? Oh, you refer to the fiduciary house. Very well.

dialogues.speaker: Shaozu
dialogues.text: Haha, I fear people only use the term "bank" nowadays. In that case, I'll be off for now. I'll return to collect the goods once you've received the funds.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zhongli!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: My friends. Have you been doing well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been great! How about you? Paimon didn't know you were such a busy consultant!

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: My days have been quite pleasant as well. I had been quietly enjoying a cup of tea when Mr. Shaozu requested my services.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: As for you, Ms. Xianyun... I presume you must be looking to settle in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: ...I must say, the name "Xianyun" sounds exceedingly strange coming from you. Perhaps you could dispense of that particular epithet in further conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Whatever for? Am I not addressing you as a friend should?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Well, that is true, but—

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: *sigh* Alas, refer to me however you will. After all, a name exists such that others may address you with it. One is hardly ignorant of that fact.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Haha, it would seem that you have gained many valuable insights over the years, Cloud Retainer.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has, indeed. One's previous stays were all brief. Now that one has made up one's mind to move and settle, one has gained a much better appreciation of the hubbub and commotion of the city, as well as the people's hard work and ardor.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: This city... is much changed from how it was more than a thousand years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Not unlike the ocean tides, so too shall the movement of people ebb and flow. From turmoil to peace, enlightenment to aspiration — human society possesses limitless potential. In another thousand years, the scene we witness here may change in ways that are impossible for either of us to imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, that's enough reflection for one day! No need to get all sentimental on us.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: You make a valid point, Paimon. Now that the sale has concluded, what say one plays the host as we try some specialty dishes together? One must profess great interest in trying "Bamboo Shoot Soup."

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Hmm? Perhaps you have forgotten, Cloud Retainer, but I once tried my hand at that dish. You were at the table on that occasion, so logic dictates that you should have already tried it.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Oh? ... What occasion was this?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It was a reunion between friends several centuries ago. Alas, you must have been too preoccupied to secure yourself a portion. Or perhaps our other companions simply availed themselves of faster reflexes on that occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Ha! Hardly! 'Twas most certainly out of consideration for the others in attendance. In but a moment, one will show you what it means to have a true deftness of hand.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: It is settled, then. Bamboo Shoot Soup, Mora Meat, Crab Roe Tofu, Triple-Layered Consommé... We shall enjoy the lot.

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: One has already passed word to Shenhe and Ganyu to make a reservation. It is prime time for them to meet one's newest disciple. Is that agreeable to everyone?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: It should be a most splendid occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, Cloud Retainer!

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Shuyu! Come now, it is time to dine. Ah, this gentleman over here is Mr. Zhongli, he is... Erm...

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A humble employee of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Pleased to make your acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Nice to meet you too, Mr. Zhongli.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should be everyone, right? Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Shuyu
dialogues.text: Sounds good! Actually, Master, have you ever tried "Adeptus' Temptation"? I heard it's impossible to stop eating after even just one bite! Y'know, cause it's super tempting and stuff. Is that true?

dialogues.speaker: Xianyun
dialogues.text: Hmm, that sounds rather implausible. Although, with the right preparation, certain dishes can be too delicious to resist...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Why are you all walking so fast? Hey, wait for Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, wait up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, didn't we promise Xingqiu that we'd tell him what we found out?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, should we make a trip to the Feiyun Commerce Guild? It's totally up to you!
